description_en: Retrieves the list of Live to VOD videos
description_zh: 调用本接口获取直播转点播视频列表
kebab_example: aliyun vod list-live-record-video --stream-name live-test --domain-name example.com --app-name testApp --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --sort-by CreationTime:Desc --start-time 2017-01-11T12:00:00Z --end-time 2017-01-11T13:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListLiveRecordVideo

parameters.description_en:
The sorting method for results. Valid values:

- **CreationTime:Desc** (default): sorted by creation time in descending order.
- **CreationTime:Asc**: sorted by creation time in ascending order.
parameters.description_zh:
结果排序。取值：

- **CreationTime:Desc**（默认值）：按创建时间倒序。
- **CreationTime:Asc**：按创建时间升序。
